functions.name: PalAnimation
functions.notes: Creates a task with zeroed 28-byte data and a child sentinel; stores sprite at +0, delay at +4, flags at +16, running=1 at +20. Does not reset the source rectangle. The first task callback reads the sprite dimensions/cell dimensions, stores their selected-axis quotient in u16 at +14, zeros current u16 at +12 and loop latch u32 at +24, samples cached PAL time into +8, then changes the task callback. Each update, when running and unsigned wrapping(now-last)>=delay, advances exactly one u16 frame. Equality with frame_count resets to zero and sets the loop latch. Updates the selected cell and resets last=now; no catch-up loop or accumulated remainder. Pointer ownership: sprite: borrowed until the animation is released; flags: value; frame_delay_ms: value. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationEx
functions.notes: Creates 24-byte task data: sprite+0, borrowed frames+4, current_duration+8, last_time+12, current_frame+16, running+20. Sets current_frame=0 and running=1 and immediately applies frame0 rectangle. First task callback copies frame0.duration to current_duration and samples cached PAL time; later callback advances at most once when unsigned elapsed reaches duration. Advance replaces current index with the old record next field, reads next duration before checking next==-1, then applies the new rectangle and resets last time only for nonterminal next. Terminal -1 keeps the last displayed rectangle. Pointer ownership: sprite: borrowed until release; frames: borrowed until release or ResetEx replaces the pointer. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationGetAnimationPoint
functions.notes: No task-type check. For Ex this is the signed frame index; for a zero-initialized sheet payload it is the flags byte widened by the three zero padding bytes, not the current u16 sheet frame. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationGetTime
functions.notes: For a sheet this is the unmodified 32-bit delay. For Ex it is the native frame-array pointer, not a delay. No task-type check. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationLoopIs
functions.notes: If task and task_data exist and data+24 is nonzero, clear that dword and return1; otherwise return0. This consumes the sheet loop event. Calling it on the 24-byte Ex data reads beyond that payload. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationRelease
functions.notes: Null returns0. Any nonnull task argument returns1 after scheduling task release; this does not destroy or reset the borrowed sprite. Release is deferred through the PAL task system. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationReset
functions.notes: Null task or task_data returns0; otherwise select sprite cell(0,0), set last_time=now, current u16=0 and loop latch=0. Does not modify running, delay or frame_count, and does not recompute dimensions. Returns1 even if the internal sprite operation fails. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationResetEx
functions.notes: Null task or task_data returns0; otherwise replace borrowed frame pointer, current=0, running=1, apply frame0 rectangle, load its duration and last_time=now. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call; frames: borrowed until release or another ResetEx. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationSetTime
functions.notes: Null task/data returns0. Otherwise writes the raw second word to data+4 and cached time to data+8; returns1. No task-type check or delay clamp. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call; frame_delay_ms: value. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

functions.name: PalAnimationStart
functions.notes: Null task/data returns0; otherwise writes 1 to task_data+20 and returns1. Sheet and Ex exports perform the same offset write. Does not rebase time; resuming after a long stop may advance immediately. Pointer ownership: animation: borrowed for the call. Native task pointers are never portable arena keys. See reverse/contracts/text_animation.json for nullability, per-build addresses, callback helpers and typed-adapter safety differences.

layouts.name: PalAnimationFrame32
layouts.ownership: Array is borrowed and remains live until animation release or replacement; next==-1 is terminal. Native still reads duration at index-1 before testing it.
layouts.gap: Portable record currently lacks repr(C) assertions and owns the array; a native layout must be declared separately or made shared before adding an ABI adapter.

integration_notes: Merge functions into pal32.json and regenerate with the central generator before accepting implementation.
Generator needs uint8_t, PalTaskOpaque *, const PalAnimationFrame32 *, and a 24-byte PalAnimationFrame32 layout.
PalAnimationFrameRecord now has repr(C) and compile-time size/alignment/offset checks; ABI module may re-export it as PalAnimationFrame32 to share the actual value layout.

Task data layouts are opaque: sheet28 bytes: sprite ptr+0,delay u32+4,last u32+8,current u16+12,count u16+14,flags u8+16,pad3,running i32+20,looped i32+24. Ex24 bytes: sprite ptr+0,frames ptr+4,current_duration u32+8,last u32+12,index i32+16,running i32+20.
